title: Respiration: data question set (20 marks)
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Review of Key Stage 3 and working scientifically (9C)
source: Written for science/y9 lesson 51 (Respiration data question set (20 marks) and mark scheme (portal))
intro: Answer every question. Show working and units for calculations. Mark it with the mark scheme.

questions.q: Write the word equation for aerobic respiration.
questions.a: Glucose + oxygen → carbon dioxide + water (2: reactants 1, products 1)

questions.q: Write the word equation for anaerobic respiration in muscles.
Give two differences between aerobic and anaerobic respiration.
questions.a: Aerobic uses oxygen, anaerobic does not (1); aerobic releases more energy (1); products differ (1); max 2

questions.q: A pupil's breathing rate is 14 breaths a minute at rest and 35 after exercise. Calculate the percentage increase.
Explain why breathing rate and heart rate increase during exercise.
questions.a: Muscles respire faster (1), needing more oxygen and glucose (1) and removing more carbon dioxide (1)

questions.q: Explain why muscles ache after hard exercise.
questions.a: Anaerobic respiration (1) makes lactic acid, which builds up in the muscles (1)

questions.q: Yeast respires anaerobically. Name the two products.
In a yeast experiment, the balloon on flask A (25 °C) grew 4 cm and on flask B (40 °C) 9 cm. What do the results show?
questions.a: Respiration (gas production) is faster at the higher temperature (1); enzymes work faster nearer their optimum (1)

questions.q: Name one variable to control in the yeast experiment.
questions.a: Mass of yeast, mass of sugar, volume of water, time (any one)

questions.q: Where in the cell does aerobic respiration happen?
Why do cells need to respire?
questions.a: To release energy for living processes (for example muscle contraction, growth)
